create_contact_area_instance: create a ContactArea object with a base image and contour threshold for contact detection
run_contact_area_detection: run the ContactArea callable on a target image to detect contact area and return major and minor axes
compute_image_diff: compute the normalized difference between a target and base image using the ContactArea _diff method
extract_contours_from_diff: extract contours from a smoothed difference image using thresholding and morphological erosion
fit_ellipse_to_contour: fit an ellipse to a contour and compute its major and minor axis endpoints
